blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We present TTLab’s submission to the AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask 3 on Arabic MT error span detection and classification.
Our system frames the task as token-level classification over surface forms, preserving character offsets to ensure exact alignment with the evaluation metric.
To handle severe label imbalance, we employ a focal loss with class weighting and dialect-specific decoding thresholds. Among six Arabic pre-trained encoders, MARBERTv2 achieves the best overall performance of 40.8 and 40.91 on the development and test set, respectively, ranking 3 rd out of all participating teams.
While our system localizes error spans effectively, classification of rare error types remains challenging, highlighting the need for data augmentation for tail categories. The code is available at TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026 .
blocks.zh:
TTLab向亚历山大X-2026分任务3提交的阿拉伯MT误差跨度检测和分类报告。
我们的系统将这项任务设定为表面表格上的象征性分类,保留字符抵消,以确保与评价衡量标准准确一致。
为了处理严重的标签失衡,我们采用了带有类加权和方言专用解码阈值的焦值损失. 在6个阿拉伯语预训编码器中,MARBERTv2在开发和测试集上分别取得了40.8和40.91的最佳总体成绩,在所有参赛球队中排名第3位.
虽然我们的系统将误差定位有效跨度,但稀有误差类型的分类仍然具有挑战性,突出表明了尾端类别的数据增强需要. 该代码可在亚历山大X-2026的TTLab获得.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Machine translation (MT) into dialectal Arabic remains substantially harder than into Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) Alabdullah et al. (2025) , and sentence-level quality estimation is often too coarse for downstream applications like post-editing. Dialectal Arabic poses unique challenges: non-standard orthography, dialect-specific morphosyntactic patterns, and scarce parallel corpora. Fine-grained error span detection (locating exact erroneous substrings and labeling their category) provides the granularity these workflows require Jung et al. (2023) , but remains under-explored for Arabic dialects.
AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask 3 El Mekki et al. (2026) addresses this gap: given an English source and its Arabic dialect MT output, systems must return every inaccurate character span with a category from a six-type linguistically motivated inventory ( Magdy et al., 2026 ) . The task spans five English-to-dialect directions and is evaluated at the exact character-offset level.
The official baseline fine-tunes a 3B-parameter generative LLM (NileChat) to produce JSON-encoded spans. However, this generative paradigm introduces three inefficiencies: (i) brittle JSON parsing (malformed output yields empty predictions), (ii) unreliable offset prediction (models must learn to generate character indices as text), and (iii) poor sample efficiency (completion-only loss ignores the discriminative signal from 80% non-error tokens). Our surface-tagging formulation directly addresses these by reframing the task as discriminative token classification.
We present TTLab’s submission: a surface-tagging approach that (i) preserves character offsets via sub-word tokenization, (ii) uses focal loss with down-weighted no-error labels to handle severe imbalance, and (iii) employs dialect-specific confidence thresholds. Among six Arabic pre-trained encoders, MARBERTv2 achieves the best performance (40.8 on dev, 40.9 on test), substantially outperforming its peers.
blocks.zh:
机器译为方言阿拉伯语(MT)仍然比现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA)阿拉布杜拉等人(2025年)难得多,句子级别的质量估计对于编辑后等下游应用来说往往过于粗糙. 糖尿病提出了独特的挑战:非标准矫形,方言特有的形态图案,以及稀缺的平行蝎子. 精细的误差跨度检测(分配准确的误差子字符串并标注其类别)提供了这些工作流程需要的颗粒性Jung等人(2023年),但对阿拉伯语方言的探索仍然不足.
AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask 3 El Mekki et al. (2026年):鉴于英语来源及其阿拉伯语方言MT输出,系统必须返回每一个不准确的字符段,从六类语言驱动的盘点中取出一个类别(Magdy et al., 2026年). 任务跨越5个英语对英语方向,并按准确的字符对调级别进行评估.
官方基线微调3B参数的基因LLM(NileChat),以产生JSON编码跨度. 然而,这种基因模式引入了三个低效率:(一) Brittle JSON 剖析(成型输出产生空预测),(二) 不可靠的抵消预测(模型必须学习生成字符指数作为文本),(三) 样本效率差(只完成损失忽略了来自80%的非刻痕的歧视性信号)。 我们的表面标记法将任务重新划分为歧视性符号分类,直接涉及这些问题。
我们提出TTLab的呈文:一种表面调制方法,即(一) 通过子词符号化来保留字符抵消,(二) 使用减重无误标签的焦值损失来处理严重的不平衡,(三) 采用方言特有的信任阈值。 在6个阿拉伯语预训编码器中,MARBERTv2取得了最佳性能(dev有40.8个,测试有40.9个),表现大大超过同行.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews relevant work on MT quality estimation and Arabic dialectal NLP. Section 3 describes the task and dataset. Section 4 presents our system architecture and training methodology. Section 5 details our experimental setup, and Section 6 reports and analyzes the results. Finally, Section 7 concludes and discusses future directions.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第二节审查了MT质量估计和阿拉伯语方言NLP的相关工作。 第3节描述了任务和数据集。 第4节介绍了我们的系统架构和培训方法。 第5节详细介绍了我们的实验设置,第6节报告并分析了结果。 最后,第7节结束并讨论了今后的方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) framework defines an open, extensible vocabulary of translation error types applicable to human and machine translation alike Lommel et al. (2014) . Freitag et al. (2021) established MQM-grounded expert error annotation as the reference methodology for MT evaluation, re-scoring top WMT systems with professional annotators.
The LQM-style category scheme of AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask 3 El Mekki et al. (2026) follows this tradition: errors are annotated as text spans, each carrying a category label.
blocks.zh:
多层面质量计量(MQM)框架界定了适用于人类和机器翻译的开放式、可扩展的翻译错误类型的词汇,如Lommel等人(2014年)。 Freitag等人(2021年)将基于MQM的专家差错注释作为MT评价的参考方法,与专业的注释者重新评分最高的WMT系统.
AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask 3 El Mekki et al. (2026)的LQM类分类方案遵循了这一传统:错误作为文本跨度附加注释,每个都带有一个类别标签.

blocks.en:
Predicting such annotations automatically has moved from sentence-level scores to fine-grained outputs.
The WMT 2022 QE shared task adopted MQM annotations for sentence- and word-level quality prediction Zerva et al. (2022) , and WMT 2023 introduced a dedicated fine-grained error span detection task, asking systems to predict error spans rather than binary ok/bad tags WMT QE Shared Task Organizers (2023) .
Learned metrics have followed: xCOMET couples sentence-level evaluation with the detection and categorisation of error spans Guerreiro et al. (2024) , while GEMBA-MQM prompts GPT-4 to mark MQM error spans without references Kocmi and Federmann (2023) .
Our task shares this span-plus-category formulation, but targets dialectal Arabic as an under-resourced target language with only ∼ \sim 1.1k training sentences.
blocks.zh:
预测这种说明会自动从句子等级的分数转为精细的产出。
WMT 2022 QE共享任务采用 MQM 注释用于句子和词层质量预测 Zerva et al. (2022), WMT 2023引入了专用的细纹误差跨度检测任务,要求系统预测误差跨度而不是二进制 ok/ bad tags WMT QE 共享任务组织者(2023).
所学的衡量标准如下: xCOMET配对句级评价,对错误的检测和分类跨度为Guerreiro等人(2024年),而GEMBA-MQM则提示GPT-4标注MQM错误跨度,无需参考Kocmi和Federmann(2023年).
我们的任务是分享这一跨加类的表述,但将方言阿拉伯语作为资源不足的目标语言,只有\\sim 1.1k培训句。

blocks.en:
Casting error identification as token-level tagging rather than generation has strong precedent: MaTESe reframes MT evaluation as a sequence-tagging problem over error spans Perrella et al. (2022) , and GECToR showed that a tag-based encoder outperforms rewriting for error-focused tasks Omelianchuk et al. (2020) .
Our surface tagger follows this line, a token classifier over the raw
MT output whose offsets recover exact character spans, with a focal loss Lin et al. (2018) against the extreme o -class imbalance, built on Arabic pre-trained encoders: MARBERT/MARBERTv2, pre-trained on diverse Arabic varieties including dialectal text Abdul-Mageed et al. (2021) ; CAMeLBERT, with variant-specific models for MSA, dialectal, and classical Arabic Inoue et al. (2021) ; and AraBERT, which established the value of Arabic-specific pre-training over multilingual models Antoun et al. (2020) . Consistent with its dialectal pre-training, we find the MARBERTv2 family strongest for tagging dialectal MT output
(Section 6 ).
blocks.zh:
将误差识别作为符号级标记而不是生成,有很强的先例:MATESe将MT评价重新设定为对误差进行测序的问题跨越Perrella等人(2022年),GECToR显示,基于标记的编码器重写Omelianchuk等人(2020年)重写重聚焦误差的任务,其性能超标.
我们的表面标记器沿着这条线, 一个符号分类器在原始上
抵消准确字符跨度的MT输出,Lin等人(2018年)与极端o-类不平衡的焦点损失,该产出建立在阿拉伯语预培训编码器上:MARBERT/MARBERTv2, 包括方言文本Abdul-Mageed等人(2021年);CAMELBERT, 具有MSA、方言和古典阿拉伯语Inoue等人(2021年)的变种模式;以及AraBERT, 确定了阿拉伯语预培训相对于多语模式Antoun等人(2020年)的价值。 我们发现MARBERTv2家族对方言MT输出的标记最强
(第6节)

blocks.en: 3 Task and Data
blocks.zh: 3 任务和数据

blocks.en:
We use the official dataset El Mekki et al. (2026) . Each instance consists of an English source sentence, a machine-generated Arabic dialect translation (the model_prediction ), and a list of gold error annotations.
Every error is specified by its verbatim text span, character-level start and end offsets into the translation, and a category from the set {graphetics, morphosyntax, orthography, pragmatics, semantics, sociolinguistics} based on Magdy et al. 2026 . The data are organized by dialect direction: ENG_EGY , ENG_MAU , ENG_MOR , ENG_PAL , and ENG_UAE .
blocks.zh:
我们使用官方数据集El Mekki等人(2026年). 每个实例包括英语源句,机器生成的阿拉伯语方言翻译(the model_prespective),以及金质错误说明列表.
每一个错误都由其逐字记录的文本跨度来指定,字符级的起始和结尾抵消到翻译中,以及基于Magdy et al的集 {graphics, mortosyntax, orthography, 务实,语义, 社会语言学}的一类. 2026 (英语). 数据按方言方向排列:ENG_EGY,ENG_MAU,ENG_MOR,ENG_PAL,以及ENG_UAE.

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes the training set statistics. Two properties dominate every design decision.
First, the data are small : 1,125 training sentences contain only 1,997 error spans (mean 1.78 per sentence).
Second, the label distribution is heavily imbalanced: roughly 80% of all tokens carry no error, and the category distribution ranges from sociolinguistics (57.9%) down to graphetics (only 2 spans in the entire training set).
We therefore collapse the three rarest categories { orthography , pragmatics , and graphetics } into a single other class during training, while retaining morphosyntax , semantics , and sociolinguistics as explicit categories. The collapsed other class is expanded back to the most frequent original category at post-processing for scoring.
blocks.zh:
表1汇总了培训统计数据。 每个设计决定都以两个属性为主.
首先,数据很少:1 125个培训句只包含1 997个错误跨度(平均每句1.78个)。
其次,标签分布严重不平衡:大约80%的所有符都携带没有错误,类别分布从社会语言学(57.9%)到石刻学(整个培训集只有2个跨度).
因此,我们在训练期间将三个罕见的类别({正字法、实用学和石刻学})分解为另一类,同时保留形态学、语义学和社会语言学作为明确类别。 倒闭的其他班级被扩展回处理后最频繁的原类,以进行评分.

blocks.en: 4 System Overview
blocks.zh: 4 系统概览

blocks.en: Tokenization and Surface Representation
blocks.zh: 触摸和表面显示

blocks.en:
The core design choice of our system is to tag the surface form of the MT output exactly as produced by the encoder’s sub-word tokenizer, preserving the character offsets that map each token back to the original string.
We deliberately do not apply any normalization, stemming, or diacritic removal, because the evaluation compares predicted and gold spans by their character offsets in the original translation.
Any transformation that shifts character positions would break the alignment between a predicted token and the exact span expected by the metric. Tagging the raw surface thus keeps the offset bridge exact.
blocks.zh:
我们系统的核心设计选择是将MT输出的表面形式与编码器的子词代号所生成的完全一样标记,保留字符抵消将每个符号映射回原字符串.
我们故意不实行任何正常化、阻止或取消批评,因为评价比较了预测和黄金间距,其特征在原始翻译中抵消。
任何改变人物位置的转变,都会打破预测符号与衡量标准预期的确切长度之间的一致。 从而保持了桥面的平衡

blocks.en: Joint Error Detection and Classification
blocks.zh: 联合错误检测和分类

blocks.en:
We formulate the task as per-token classification. Each gold error span induces the corresponding label for every token it overlaps; all other tokens receive the O (no error) label.
During inference, contiguous non- O tokens of the same category are merged into a single error span, and the stored character offsets are used to map it back to the exact character positions ( s , e , c ) (s,e,c) required by the scorer.
blocks.zh:
我们按分类来制定任务。 每个金质错误跨度都会诱导它重叠的每个符号对应的标签;所有其他符号都会收到O(无错误)标签.
在推论期间,毗连的非 O类的符号被合并成一个单一的误差跨度,存储的字符偏移用于将其映射回计分者所需的精确字符位置(s, e, c) (s, e, c).

blocks.en: Imbalance-Aware Objective
blocks.zh: 不平衡- 意识目标

blocks.en:
Because the O label dominates, a standard cross-entropy loss would cause the model to over-predict "no error." We therefore minimize a focal loss Lin et al. (2018) with down-weighted O : ℒ = − 1 N ∑ i α y i ( 1 − p i , y i ) γ log p i , y i , \mathcal{L}=-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}\alpha_{y_{i}}(1-p_{i,y_{i}})^{\gamma}\log p_{i,y_{i}}, where p i = softmax ⁡ ( 𝐳 i ) p_{i}=\mathrm{softmax}(\mathbf{z}_{i}) and y i y_{i} is the gold label. We set the focusing parameter γ = 2 \gamma=2 and use class weights α O = 0.3 \alpha_{\text{O}}=0.3 , α c = 1 \alpha_{c}=1 for c ∈ 𝒞 c\in\mathcal{C} ; padding and special tokens are excluded from the loss computation.
The down-weighting of O prevents the 80% non-error majority from dominating the gradient, while the focal term sharpens the focus on hard, rare error tokens.

blocks.en: Decoding and Dialect-Specific Thresholds
blocks.zh: 解码和分辨阈值

blocks.en:
At inference time we compute the per-token error probability 1 − p i , O 1-p_{i,\text{O}} . A token is flagged as an error when this probability exceeds a dialect-specific threshold τ d \tau_{d} , and its category is determined by arg ⁡ max c ∈ 𝒞 ⁡ p i , c \arg\max_{c\in\mathcal{C}}p_{i,c} .
Contiguous tokens with the same category are merged, and their offsets define the character span. The thresholds { τ d } \{\tau_{d}\} are tuned on out-of-fold (OOF) cross-validation predictions to maximize each dialect’s overall score.
Using a separate τ d \tau_{d} per direction is critical because the dialects exhibit substantially different error densities (see Table 1 ); a single global threshold would systematically over- or under-predict in different dialects.
A light post-processing step trims leading/trailing whitespace and punctuation from the predicted spans and discards spans shorter than two characters. For final scoring, the collapsed other class is mapped to the most frequent original category among the merged tokens.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en:
We fine-tune each encoder end-to-end using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , batch size 16, and maximum sequence length 192. Gradient clipping is set to 1.0, and all models are trained with the focal loss defined in Section 4 .
Results are reported as five-fold cross-validation on the training set (out-of-fold, OOF). The official development set (138 sentences) is used only as a secondary reference for backbone selection and diagnostics because single-split scores at this size are noisy; the one system decision made on dev is the character-level ensemble’s vote threshold v v (see the “Character-Level Voting Ensemble” paragraph below), which has no OOF analogue in our pipeline.
blocks.zh:
我们用 AdamW 对每个编码器端对端进行微调, 学习速度为 2× 10− 5 2\times 10× 5}, 批量尺寸 16, 最大序列长度 192。 渐变剪辑设定为1.0,所有模型都用第4节定义的焦损失来训练.
培训结果报告为培训内容的五倍交叉鉴定(外加,OOF)。 官方开发集(138句)仅用作骨干选择和诊断的次要参考,因为这种大小的单片分数很吵;关于dev的一个系统决定是字符级综艺的投票门槛v(见下面的"Character-level vote Squotion Ensemble"段落),它没有OOF的类似词.

We compare six Arabic pre-trained encoders within the identical surface-tagging pipeline: MARBERTv2 Abdul-Mageed et al. (2021) ,
a MARBERTv2 cross-encoder checkpoint fine-tuned on QuranQA 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/yoriis/marbertv2-crossencoder-quranqa25 , CAMeLBERT-DA Inoue et al. (2021) , SaudiBERT Qarah (2024) , AraBERTv2 Antoun et al. (2020) ,
and NileChat-3B El Mekki et al. (2025) used as a token tagger.
This sweep selects the final backbone; Table 2 reports the results.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了6个阿拉伯预训编码器,
a MARBERTv2交叉编码器检查站在《古兰经》第11章上进行了微调。 Inoue等人(2021年)、SaudiBERT QARAH(2024年)、AraBERTv2 Antoun等人(2020年),
和NileChat-3B El Mekki等人(2025年)用作标志标记器。
此扫描选择最后的主干线; 表2报告结果。

blocks.en:
Tuning a separate confidence threshold for each dialect, rather than a single global threshold, yields consistent gains of up to 0.8 points in overall OOF score.
The light post-processing (span trimming and minimum length filtering) adds a further 0.3-0.5 points.
Both components are retained in the final system.
blocks.zh:
为每种方言制定单独的置信阈值,而不是单一的全球阈值,在OOF总得分中产生高达0.8分的一贯收益。
光后处理(span trimming和最小长度过滤)又增加了0.3-0.5分.
这两个组成部分都保留在最后系统中。

blocks.en:
As an extension, we build a character-level voting ensemble on top of the six per-backbone taggers. Each model independently decodes its spans; a character position is considered part of an error if at least v v models agree, and the category is decided by a weighted majority vote.
Sweeping the vote threshold v v interpolates between the union (higher recall) and intersection (higher precision) of the individual taggers. The best operating point on the dev set is reported in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
作为扩展,我们在6个每背骨标记器上搭建一个字符级的投票组合. 每个模型独立解码其跨度;一个字符位置如果至少v v模型同意,则被认为是错误的一部分,类别由加权多数投票决定.
擦除投票门槛 v v 插值介于单个标记者的结合(更高的召回)和交叉(更高的精度)之间. Dev集上的最佳操作点见表2。

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows that MARBERTv2 is the strongest backbone, achieving 39.4 OOF and 40.8 Dev.
It is followed by the MARBERTv2 cross-encoder checkpoint (38.9/38.5), and then by the dialectal CAMeLBERT-DA and SaudiBERT (both 36.7 OOF). AraBERTv2 and the generative NileChat-3B perform considerably worse. The MARBERTv2 family clearly dominates, and we select it as the final backbone.

随后是MARBERTv2跨编码检查站(38.9/38.5),然后是方言CAMELBERT-DA和SaudiBERT(均为36.7 OOF). AraBERTv2和基因型的尼罗茶-3B的表现要糟糕得多. MARBERTV2家族显然占据主导地位,我们选择它作为最后的骨干.

blocks.en:
Decomposing the metric reveals a consistent pattern: at the best operating points of both single models and the ensemble, the overlap-span F 1 F_{1} reaches 46-48, while the error-category micro- F 1 F_{1} is only 31-33.
A matched-span analysis indicates that when the model correctly localizes an error, it usually assigns the correct category.
The residual category loss is driven primarily by undetected spans (which are category false negatives) and by the extremely rare classes (2-83 training examples each), not by misclassification of detected spans.
blocks.zh:
分解度量显示一个一致的图案:在单模型和综艺的最佳操作点,重叠-span F 1 F_{1}达到46-48,而错误-类别-微-F 1 F_{1}只有31-33.
匹配宽度分析表明,当模型正确定位一个错误时,通常会指定正确的类别.
造成剩余类别损失的主要因素是未被发现的跨度(属于类别假负数)和极罕见的班级(每班2至83个培训实例),而不是对检测到的跨度进行错误分类。

blocks.en: Because { τ d } \{\tau_{d}\} in Section 4 is tuned and evaluated on the same pooled OOF predictions, we additionally run a nested (leave-one-fold-out) variant: for each fold, thresholds are tuned only on the other four folds’ OOF predictions before scoring the held-out fold. For the submitted MARBERTv2 configuration this lowers the OOF overall score from 39.4 (pooled, as in Table 2 ) to 35.4 (nested), a ∼ \sim 4-point gap that we attribute to the pooled procedure’s mild overfitting to the OOF set it is also scored on. We take 35.4 to be the more honest OOF estimate and report it alongside the original in Table 4 .

blocks.en: Table 4 isolates two design choices. Replacing focal loss with weighted cross-entropy loses 0.8 nested-OOF and 1.9 dev-macro- F 1 F_{1} points, confirming focal weighting is a modest but consistent contributor. More notably, training on all six categories directly (no collapse) matches or exceeds the submitted configuration on every metric, including dev macro- F 1 F_{1} (18.2 vs. 16.3), because orthography recovers a category-specific signal (OOF F 1 F_{1} 9.6 vs. 4.9 from the fixed fallback) and pragmatics moves off zero; graphetics stays at 0 (2 training examples). We confirmed this on the official leaderboard by retraining and resubmitting: the no-collapse system raises the test Overall Score from 40.91 (submitted) to 42.00 (Table 3 )

blocks.en:
The character-level voting ensemble attains a dev score of 39.9 at its optimal vote threshold, improving recall and category F 1 F_{1} slightly but failing to exceed the single MARBERTv2 tagger (40.8).
Because MARBERTv2 dominates its peers, blending in weaker, correlated encoders only dilutes its predictions.
We therefore submit the single MARBERTv2 surface tagger as our final system.
blocks.zh:
角色级投票组合在其最佳投票门槛上达到39.9的Dev得分,提高了召回率和F 1 FQQQ1}类别略微但未能超过单一的MARBERTv2标记器(40.8).
因为MARBERTv2主导了它的同行,混合在较弱,相互关联的编码器中只会淡化它的预测.
因此,我们提交单一的MARBERTv2表面标记器作为我们的最终系统.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a surface-tagging approach for dialectal Arabic MT error span detection and classification that operates directly on raw, unnormalized text.
By preserving character offsets through the tokenization and modeling pipeline, we ensure exact alignment with the gold spans required by the evaluation metric. A focal loss with class weighting effectively handles the severe label imbalance, and dialect-specific confidence thresholds adapt to varying error densities.
Among six pre-trained Arabic encoders, MARBERTv2 yields the best results, and a character-level ensemble offers no further gain. Detailed analysis reveals that the system localizes errors well but struggles with the rarest categories due to extreme data scarcity.
Future work could explore data augmentation for tail categories, cross-lingual transfer from higher-resource languages, and exact-match-span optimization to better align with the official scoring regime.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一种表面调制方法,用于阿拉伯MT方言误差跨度探测和分类,直接在原始的、非正常的文字上操作。
通过标注和建模管道来保持字符抵消,确保与评价指标所要求的黄金跨度精确一致。 具有类加权的焦值损失可以有效处理严重的标签失衡,而方言特有的置信阈值可以适应不同的误差密度.
在6个经过预训的阿拉伯语编码器中,MARBERTv2产生最佳效果,一个字符级的综艺节目没有带来进一步的收益. 详细分析显示,由于数据极度稀缺,系统将错误定位得很好,但与最罕见的类别发生矛盾。
今后的工作可以探讨尾巴类别的数据扩增、从高资源语言的跨语言传输以及精确匹配的扩展优化,以便更好地与官方评分制度保持一致。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Several limitations of this work should be noted.
First, the training set is extremely small (1,125 sentences) and contains only two examples of the graphetics category, making it nearly impossible to learn that class reliably. Our collapse strategy mitigates this but does not fully solve the data sparsity problem.
Second, the system relies on a single, relatively large encoder ( MARBERTv2 ) and may not scale gracefully to resource-constrained environments.
Third, although we deliberately avoid normalization to preserve character offsets, this choice ties the system to the exact tokenization of the chosen encoder; a change of tokenizer would require re-mapping the offset annotations.
Finally, our development metric pools overlap-span F 1 F_{1} and micro-averaged category F 1 F_{1} across the whole split, whereas the confirmed official metric computes overlap-span F 1 F_{1} and error-class F 1 F_{1} per dialect direction and macro-averages each across the five directions before combining them; exact-match F 1 F_{1} (literal character-offset equality) is reported by the leaderboard separately as a diagnostic that does not enter the ranking score. Our development-set numbers are therefore a pooled/micro proxy and are not directly comparable to the official leaderboard; we did not optimize for the official aggregation directly.
blocks.zh:
应当注意到这项工作的若干局限性。
第一,训练集极其小(1,125句),只包含两个石刻类的例子,使得几乎无法可靠地学习该课. 我们的崩溃策略减轻了这种情况,但并没有完全解决数据痉挛问题.
其次,系统依赖于一个单一的,相对大的编码器(MARBERTv2),并且可能不会优雅地扩展到受资源限制的环境.
第三,虽然我们故意避免正常化来保留字符偏移,但这种选择将系统与所选编码器的精确符号化联系起来;改变符号化符则需要重新绘制偏移说明.
最后,我们的开发度量衡池与F-1 F_{1}和微观平均值的F-1 F_{1}在整个分裂中重叠,而经确认的官方度量衡的计算则与F-1 F_{1}和错误等级的F-1 F_{1}在合并之前,每个方言方向和宏观平均值跨越五个方向;精确匹配的F-1 F_{1}(文学字符-抵消平等)被领导板单独报告为诊断,没有进入排名分数. 因此,我们的开发设置数字是一个集合/微观代用,不能直接与官方领导板相比;我们没有直接优化官方汇总。
